text:
noah: Postmortem follow-up: want to turn the incident learnings into concrete test coverage + a repeatable drill. Listing proposed items and tentative owners. Please confirm or reassign.

noah: Proposed workstream breakdown:
1) curated eval prompt matrix across observed failure modes + model variants (owner: sophia)
2) CI gating job that runs the eval matrix on PRs touching serving/runtime (owner: sophia + eng-platform)
3) k6 load scenario that reproduces the short KV spike + a smaller sustained tail (owner: lee)
4) targeted chaos drill: canary routing + autoscale failure modes (owner: oliver)
5) dashboards/alerts for regression on the new prompt metrics (owner: maya)

sophia: I can take the eval matrix. Preference: store prompts in ml/evals/regressions/incident_172444 with metadata indicating model tags and tolerances. Will add a mapping file that lists which models/quant levels to run against. ETA: PR by 2026-04-06.

lee: I'll write the k6 scenario. Plan: two stages: 4m ramp to 60RPS (spike), 3m sustain 60RPS, 5m cool-down with jitter. We'll add a header to simulate real client traffic and a short KV access pattern. Script name: scripts/k6/kv_spike_pattern.js. Command for local run:

```
k6 run --vus 60 --duration 12m scripts/k6/kv_spike_pattern.js
```

lee: ETA for script + CI job in staging: 2026-04-08. Need a 30m slot in staging to validate after CI.

oliver: I'll own the chaos drill. Proposed exercise: 2-hour drill with infra + oncall + eng-ml. Objectives:
- Validate canary fallback triggers when 10% of canaries exceed latency SLO
- Validate autoscaler cooldown behavior under bursty load
- Confirm rollback checklist and playbook steps are actionable

oliver: Proposed date: 2026-04-14 15:00 UTC. Will draft runbook and failure injection steps by 2026-04-09.

maya: I'll do the dashboard panels and alerts. For eval metrics, let's expose: prompt_pass_rate, prompt_precision, prompt_latency_p50/p95. Alert rule suggestion: eval regression if prompt_pass_rate drops by >5% vs baseline over 24h. Route alerts to #eng-oncall and #eng-ml.

noah: Thanks. A few integration details:
- Sophia: include a small 'golden' file for each prompt with deterministic fields annotated. Non-deterministic tokens should be marked with placeholders.
- CI gating: run the eval matrix on PRs that touch packages/* or serving/*, but allow opt-out with label 'eval-skip' for non-critical infra changes.
- Naming convention: PRs should be ml/evals/incident_172444/<short-desc>.json and include a tests/fixture mapping.

Sophia: Example eval JSON I'll include to make imports easier:

```
{
  "id": "incident_172444_prompt_01",
  "tags": ["streaming", "kv-miss", "drop"],
  "prompt": "User requests a long streaming summary while intermittent token drops occur",
  "golden": "<partial summary that is tolerant to dropped tokens>",
  "tolerances": {"levenshtein": "<= 3", "allow_placeholder_tokens": true}
}
```

noah: For the CI gating job, eng-platform: can we make the eval run incremental and short? Run first N=5 prompts per PR then schedule the full matrix nightly. If a PR fails a short run, require owner ack.

maya: That sounds good. I'll add a dashboard that shows short-run pass rates and a separate historical panel for nightly full-run regressions.

oncall-bot: FYI: include #eng-oncall in alert targets and escalation policy: 15m ack window then page SRE oncall.

lee: One technical ask: do we have a canonical trace from the incident (span IDs + example requests) to emulate in k6 payloads? Having a real header set will improve fidelity.

oliver: I'll attach the trace to the postmortem doc by EOD. Also adding a checklist in the runbook to capture traces during the next oncall rotation.

noah: Action item recap with owners and due dates (I'll add to the postmortem checklist and create GitHub issues):
- sophia  eval prompt matrix + PR (due 2026-04-06)
- lee  k6 kv_spike_pattern + staging CI job (due 2026-04-08)
- oliver  chaos drill + runbook (drill on 2026-04-14, runbook by 2026-04-09)
- maya  dashboards + alerts (due 2026-04-07)
- eng-platform  CI gating incremental run + nightly full (initial work by 2026-04-10)

noah: I'll set up a weekly status sync on Mondays until everything is closed. calendar-bot: please schedule a recurring 30m on Mondays for owners.

calendar-bot: Recurring event created: "Eval incident follow-ups" Mondays 09:00 UTC starting 2026-03-30, invitees: sophia, lee, oliver, maya, noah, eng-platform.

noah: Confirmed. If anyone needs to shift ownership, please update the postmortem checklist and ping me. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
